title: 4chan whistleblower: higher-ups think the visitors treat Earth like a zoo

tellings.quote: that they just don't care about us. Like, they just don't care. They don't care. It's more like a zoo where they're

plain: Chris Ramsay, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, retells the claims of an anonymous self-described whistleblower who posted on 4chan, an online message board, in early 2023. According to Ramsay, the poster said the people in charge believe the visitors simply do not care about us, and treat Earth more like a zoo. If true, it would mean we are being watched, not engaged.
